text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond has poured all her effort 
into overcoming her weaknesses with rainy 
days and pacing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Satono Diamond Polishing Project." 
This is part of that endeavor as well...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Behold, this is... the VR Umalator "Satono 
Special Program (Prototype)"!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The Satono family made an RPG a while 
back. I've customized it just for 
training!
choice_data_list: You can train while you play!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
A prototype packed with the Satono 
family's technology. I'm so excited to see 
what kind of adventure awaits us!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Logged into the game!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Now, the first thing to aim for is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh?! Is something glowing over there...? 
I'll go take a look!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Dia?! Where are you going?! We have 
to get your gear ready first!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! I got carried away. Um, 
the path leading to the village is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's a Rainbow Mushroom! I wonder 
what it feels like? Is it fluffy...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Satono Diamond's intense 
curiosity often led her to dash off ahead, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... We finally made it. The 
final dungeon!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Mr. Final Boss Dragon! Fufu, I wonder 
what kind of face you have—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Look out!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next moment, my body was floating in 
midair! Wh-What is this—?!
choice_data_list: She's being carried away by a dragon?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where we were brought was a lair of 
dragons. There were dragons of various 
sizes, but they were asleep now, posing no 
danger. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm worried about the Umamusume... 
especially Satono Diamond. I hope her 
curiosity hasn't led her into danger—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'll draw the minions over here! Dia, take 
care of Trainer!
choice_data_list: It's dangerous, get out of there!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: It's all right. I will surely save you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Continuing to use technique after 
technique inevitably leaves an opening. If 
that's the case, by drawing them in and 
forcing them to keep using their moves...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(The real question is... whether I can 
maintain my pace without gapping out so my 
stamina lasts—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I'll be fine, for sure. With the 
special training I've gone through!

text_block_list.name: Dragon
text_block_list.text: *Hiss... Growwwwwwl...*

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: âI see it! Dragon, prepare yourself!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahーー!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've come to escort you... Now, take my 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Defeating enemies several times his size 
all the while, he says those words and 
extends a gentlemanly hand. That figure of 
his was just like—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Are you all right? You've seemed 
a bit out of it for a while now...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—You're totally entranced by that knightly 
figure, aren't you? ♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Unlike me, who's been playing pretend 
adventures with you since we were kids, 
Trainer isn't used to this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To Dia's bravery in stepping up when it 
matters most!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My! Fufufu, then it's the opposite of 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll be your escort today♪ Right to the 
goal of this game!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Kura-chan. Thank you so much for 
today. Thanks to you both—
choice_data_list: You've really grown, haven't you, Dia...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No—I still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Dragon
text_block_list.text: GUOOOOOOOOOH!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the dragon roared up at the sky, 
thick rain clouds covered the heavens, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Rain. Getting bogged down in the mud, 
heavy strides. But—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even in depressing weather like this... 
Even on muddy ground from the rain, hold 
your ground! If it's me right now, having 
reeled in the big one—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even in the rain, I will handle things 
brilliantly!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Now! Haaaaaaah—!

text_block_list.name: Dragon
text_block_list.text: GUOOOOOOOOOH!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When the dragon boss fell, the rain 
ceased.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've come to escort you... Now, take my 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:

all the while, he says those words and 
extends a gentlemanly hand. That figure of 
his was just like—

a bit out of it for a while now...

text_block_list.text:
—You're totally entranced by that knightly 
figure, aren't you? ♪

text_block_list.text:
Unlike me, who's been playing pretend 
adventures with you since we were kids, 
Trainer isn't used to this.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To Dia's bravery in stepping up when it 
matters most!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My! Fufufu, then it's the opposite of 
usual.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll be your escort today♪ Right to the 
goal of this game!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Kura-chan. Thank you so much for 
today. Thanks to you both—
choice_data_list: You've really grown, haven't you, Dia...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: No—I still have a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Next, emotional control. There were many 
moments where you gave in to curiosity. 
Among other things...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
OK! Once you've made up your mind, you 
never listen anyway.
choice_data_list:
Yeah! I'll stick with you, wherever you 
go!

Yeah! I'll be with you, to the ends of the 
earth!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll hone myself even more, and one 
day, my destiny...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will change this very world. I swear 
I'll become that kind of "legendary 
Umamusume"!
